themes.title: Right-Wing Political Alignment & Electoral Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across multiple nations are actively navigating electoral headwinds, internal ideological positioning, and post-election coalition dynamics. From midterm prep and GOP consolidation in the US to candidate realignment and ideological shifting in France, Sweden, and Norway, parties are adjusting their strategies to secure governance.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Focus on midterm election maneuvering, GOP unity struggles, and administration efforts to reshape voting and electoral rules.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Positioning ahead of the 2027 presidential election, highlighting ideological shifts toward France's Christian roots and internal leadership dynamics.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Navigating post-2026 election coalition gridlock and analyzing shifts in local and regional support.

countries.note: Local party list organization and regional constituency messaging ahead of upcoming electoral cycles.

themes.title: Right-Wing Realignment on Foreign Policy and Defense
themes.blurb: Right-wing factions are asserting hardline foreign policy stances, balancing nationalist defense priorities with international conflict responses. The US administration and France's Rassemblement National both emphasize firmness against hostile foreign actors while recalibrating their stances on Ukraine military support.

themes.title: Government Economic Intervention & Sectoral Impact
themes.blurb: Right-wing commentators and lawmakers are highlighting state intervention in energy and industrial sectors, targeting federal mandates and market pressures. Discussions center on deregulation, protecting domestic industrial infrastructure, and addressing rising public anxiety over cost-of-living increases.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet

themes.title: Nativist Labor Policies and Immigration Restrictions
themes.blurb: A shared rhetorical and policy focus emphasizes restricting foreign labor and curtailing immigration to protect domestic workforces. Measures range from high regulatory fees on foreign technical visas to broader political debates on the societal integration of nativist platforms.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Enforcing substantial fee increases on foreign worker visas and targeting foreign labor substitution in American firms.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
